title: Bound Modbus connection concurrency and frame length
description: The public Modbus listener uses an unbounded ThreadingTCPServer and accepts a 16-bit MBAP length with only a lower-bound check. Partial or oversized connections can allocate one native thread, socket, and buffer each until timeout, destabilizing the shared process.
acceptance_criteria: Add a strict global and per-source connection ceiling using a bounded worker or asynchronous design; reject unsupported MBAP lengths before reading the PDU; reject excess connections deterministically; add container PID, memory, and file-descriptor ceilings; stress-test partial and maximum-length frames while valid HMI and Modbus traffic remains responsive.

Validated by Codex Security plugin 0.1.18 at revision 42aafe44b0633586e3e8b15409f66f539da0eaf5. Finding: resource-exhaustion.modbus-connection-concurrency.
close_reason: Fixed: bounded global/per-source Modbus admission, strict MBAP length validation, container resource ceilings, and regression/pressure coverage (78 relevant tests passed; 420 repository tests passed, 2 unrelated Burp port conflicts).

title: Bound persistent evidence storage and retention

acceptance_criteria: Add configurable age, row, and byte retention for attacker-driven SQLite tables; cap campaigns and username cardinality globally and per source; rotate and compress JSONL; enforce free-space watermarks and a reserved health-event budget; expose dropped and retained counters; add deterministic quota, restart, and ENOSPC regression tests.
